result.fix_applied: Rebase completed LOCALLY (not pushed): dropped merge commit cea8f7125 and replayed the 4 doc-hygiene commits linearly onto origin/dev (76bb6ae11). The single rebase conflict was in specs/reachability-registry.json (the branch had reordered the whole registry against a stale base; verified via sorted prefix-set diff that its ONLY semantic delta is +docs/security-program.json). Resolved mechanically by restoring dev's canonical 96-entry file and inserting that one entry after docs/runbooks/cloud/root-of-trust-ceremony.md. The named OWNERS fix and the title #1208 fix were NOT applied and nothing was force-pushed, because the OWNERS fix is infeasible as specified (see blockers).
blockers: OWNERS born-ownership fix is infeasible as specified: docs/security-program.json is a depth-1 sibling of 2668 other docs under docs/. The ADR-0555 resolver (ci/facade/artifact-inventory-registry/src/lib.rs, resolve_owners) is directory-nearest-ancestor with a 2000-path breadth bound (oya-ci [owners] max_paths_per_owners_file).

A docs/OWNERS naming ops-security would claim 2669 tracked paths (>2000) and over-claim 2668 unrelated other-team docs (PRIVACY-PROGRAM.md=council-privacy, COMPLIANCE-MATRIX.md=ops-compliance, etc.). The sanctioned transitional bridge --fix-owners docs=ops-security REFUSES exactly this (lib.rs:1399-1409: 'a single bulk registration cannot neuter a tree unowned accounting (ADR-0555); split the registration - add OWNERS files in child subtrees so no single file covers more than 2000 paths'). After breadth truncation the target (sorts under 's') likely stays unowned anyway.

No child-subtree directory scopes to a depth-1 file, so no valid narrow OWNERS exists. The only correct fix relocates docs/security-program.json into its own child subtree (e.g. docs/security-program/) plus an OWNERS there, and repoints ~6 reference sites (README.md, .github/CODEOWNERS, docs/machine-readable/catalog.json, .github/CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml, and the reachability-registry entry). That changes the PR intended artifact path and is a design/intent decision (canonical home of the security-program DATA file), beyond the mechanical named fix.

The branch commit c01d19a87 asserted 'ownership resolves once reachable+justified' - that is false (reachability and ownership are independent axes in the resolver); the file remains UNOWNED, and unowned mode is baseline-block-on-new, so this NEW path currently RED-blocks the accounting gate. The blocker was already misdiagnosed once by the branch author, confirming it needs a real intent decision, not a mechanical patch.
PR title lacks #1208 - fixable via gh pr edit --title, but not applied since the remote was intentionally left untouched given the OWNERS blocker (avoiding a partial force-push of a still-red PR).
